title: GlobalRoleChanged
description: Published by Auth & Users to farol.auth-users with routing key global-role.changed, through the outbox (ADR-004), right after the account's UserProfileChanged when the bootstrap account is created with a verified e-mail (spec D6, #179). Consumed from events.auth-users-events: only the FarolAdmin creates and manages events (API outline §7.4). Full state with a version (§7.3). actorUserId is empty when the system granted it (the bootstrap). AMQP properties as UserProfileChanged, with type = GlobalRoleChanged.
